name: The Building Explodes
description: A sudden blast tears through the structure. Walls crumble, debris flies, and the building collapses in a cloud of dust and smoke.
related_events: Structure explodes

name: Danny's Brief Phone Call
description: Danny made a phone call, spoke or began to speak, then paused. After the pause, he hung up the phone.
related_events: Danny makes a phone call and hangs up

name: Hospital Hallway
description: A hospital hallway stretches under fluorescent lights. A placard mounted on one of the doors reads MEDICAL LAB. The door stands closed, part of the quiet, sterile corridor.
related_events: Placard indicates medical lab location

name: Power Outage in High-Rise Apartment Building
description: The lights in a high-rise apartment building suddenly go out, plunging the entire structure into darkness. Elevators stop moving, frozen between floors. Hallways and apartments are left without illumination, the usual hum of electrical appliances falling silent. Residents stand in the dark, the absence of light cutting across rooms and corridors alike.
related_events: Power outage plunges apartment building into darkness

name: Danny Narrates Methedrene Synthesis Initiation
description: An extreme close-up shows a glass pipette slowly dripping a clear liquid into a glass beaker. Danny's voice is heard in the background, stating that Methedrene was first distilled by a Japanese scientist before World War II. He adds that the Japanese recognized its value early on.
related_events: Glass pipette drips clear liquid into beaker

name: Kujo and the Courier Fight Over the Case
description: Kujo and the courier grab hold of the case, each pulling it toward themselves in a tense tug-of-war. Kujo raises a dustbuster vacuum and points it at the courier as if it were a gun, holding it steady in their direction.
related_events: Kujo and courier engage in tug-of-war over the case
Kujo threatens courier with dustbuster vacuum

name: Cashier Witnesses Late-Night Cold Medicine Purchase
description: A cashier scans container after container of cold medicine as a long-haired man with tattoos stands at the register. The man's expression is blank, his arms covered in ink. The cashier looks up, forcing a tight, uneasy smile. Outside the store, Danny's voice cuts through the silence. He describes seeing a tattooed man buying up every box of cold medicine he can find in the middle of the night. The cashier watches him, frozen in place, as the man stacks more boxes on the counter. Danny says the man doesn't have a cold—he's a cook. If you looked in his kitchen, you'd find a mix of strange ingredients, nothing like a home remedy.
related_events: Cashier scans multiple containers of cold medication
Cashier reacts to customer with frozen grin
Danny narrates warning about drug cook purchasing cold medicine

name: Surrounded and Outgunned
description: The courier peanut stands at the center as the opposing peanuts and a cashew move in, forming a tight circle around it. KUJO steps forward, voice steady, and states that with no way out and armed opponents on all sides, the courier will now comply with their demands.
related_events: Courier peanut becomes surrounded by opposing peanuts and a cashew
KUJO declares courier's inevitable compliance due to overwhelming odds

name: Danny Enters the Car in the Alley
description: Danny waited in the shadows of the alley. A car approached without headlights and came to a stop. He stepped out from the darkness, opened the back door, and lay down on the back seat.
related_events: Car without headlights arrives in alley
Danny emerges from shadows and enters car

name: Housewife Vacuums Same Spot While Smoking as Danny Narrates Stimulant Use
description: A housewife in a white dress vacuums the same spot on the floor over and over, one hand gripping the vacuum, the other holding a cigarette. Danny speaks in voiceover, mentioning Dexedrine, Benzedrine, and Methedrine, and describing how 1950s housewives used these drugs. He calls the image of a thin woman endlessly cleaning a classic sign of speed use.
related_events: Danny describes 1950s housewives' use of stimulants
Housewife obsessively vacuums the same spot while smoking

name: Kennedy and Khrushchev Meet Amid Cold War Tensions
description: President John F. Kennedy shakes hands with Soviet Premier Nikita Khrushchev in a formal encounter captured in stock footage. The handshake complete, Kennedy begins speaking with animated gestures, his expression intense and focused, while Khrushchev stands beside him, listening without response.
related_events: J.F.K. shakes hands with Nikita Khrushchev
Kennedy speaks animatedly during encounter with Khrushchev

name: Kamikaze Pilot's Final Dive and the Aftermath of War
description: A young kamikaze pilot grips the controls of his Japanese Zero, eyes wide, jaw clenched. Flames erupt as the plane slams into a battleship, engulfing both in a fireball. Archival footage captures the impact, the sky lit with smoke and debris. In the silence that follows, a voice recalls how methamphetamine use spread among Japanese soldiers, pilots, and factory workers during the war. In the years after, the drug floods cities, addiction spreading through the population. The narrator notes that some estimates place meth use at 2% of the population in the post-war period, a lingering shadow of the conflict now carried into civilian life.
related_events: Japanese Zero crashes into battleship during wartime combat

name: The Young Arms Dealer Shows His Inventory
description: A young Black boy sits at a dining room table covered with handguns, knives, rifles, and security gear. He wears a terry-cloth jumpsuit, gold jewelry, and has wet jerry-curled hair. Facing the camera, he begins speaking in a flat, husky monotone, listing the features of each weapon without pause. He starts with a Glock 9 mm, describing its finish, grip, barrel length, and magazine capacity, offering it for three hundred and fifty dollars. Without missing a beat, he moves to a Tangfolio 9 mm, highlighting its rubber grips, adjustable sights, and 16-round magazine, priced at two hundred dollars. Next is a chrome Llama Mini-Max .38 Super Auto, which he calls flashy but underwhelming, available for one hundred and fifty dollars. He then presents a Colt .357 Magnum revolver, emphasizing its power, short barrel, and six-shot capacity, recommending it for impact. Finally, he unveils a Les Baer Custom Premier Tactical .45, praising its blue finish, precision, and custom trigger, offering it for seven hundred and ninety-five dollars. He states all weapons are stolen, traceable only to original owners, all sales final, and all prices negotiable. He finishes speaking and stares directly at Danny and Jimmy, who stand frozen, wide-eyed and silent.
related_events: Young arms dealer demonstrates weapon inventory to potential buyer
Young Arms Dealer concludes sales pitch to Danny and Jimmy
Danny and Jimmy react to the arms dealer's sales pitch

name: Danny Defuses Confrontation with Polite Remark
description: A disheveled man pounds on Colette's door, drawing Danny's attention. Danny stands at his own door, fumbling with his keys as he watches. The man notices and turns to him, demanding, 'You mad dogging me, Bitch?' Danny replies, 'Heavens no. I was just admiring your boots.' The man looks down at his worn motorcycle boots. Danny asks if he bought them locally. The man ignores the question, turns away, and resumes pounding on the door. Danny says, 'Goodbye now. Nice meeting you,' and steps inside.
related_events: Trashy looking dude bangs on Colette's door
Danny fumbles with keys while observing the visitor
Dude confronts Danny about staring
Dude ignores Danny and continues pounding on the door
Danny ends interaction with polite farewell

name: Bikers Driven Underground After Government Crackdown
description: A sleepy-eyed trucker steps out of his tractor-trailer and walks toward a loitering man who resembles a Hells Angels member. In the late 1960s, government authorities intensified enforcement efforts, disrupting biker operations and pushing them out of open activity. The bikers, who had previously gained control of the illicit market, were forced to operate in secrecy.
related_events: Government crackdown forces biker operations underground
Bikers gain control of illicit market

name: Trucker Approaches Biker
description: A sleepy-eyed trucker climbs out of his tractor-trailer and walks toward a biker leaning against a roadside post. The biker, dressed in leather with a patch-covered vest, watches him approach as the truck idles behind them.
related_events: Trucker approaches Hells Angels-type biker

name: Danny Retrieves the Lockbox
description: Danny steps out of the shower, a towel wrapped around his waist. He walks to the closet, reaches up to the top shelf, and takes down a metal lockbox. He pulls a key from his pocket, unlocks the box, and places it on the bed.
related_events: Danny emerges from the shower with a towel around his waist
Danny retrieves a metal lockbox from the closet shelf
Danny unlocks the metal lockbox with a key

name: Danny Takes Out Formal Clothes
description: Danny unlocks the metal lockbox and sets it on the bed. He pauses, looking inside, then gently lifts out a white dress shirt, a pair of black slacks, and wingtip shoes.
related_events: Danny removes formal clothes from the lockbox

name: Danny and Jimmy Leave the Room
description: Danny and Jimmy exit the room, closing the door behind them. Danny looks at Jimmy and says, "Nice dealer you got there, Jimmy." Jimmy hesitates, then replies, "Oh ... that. Ah, he was just juiced. He wouldn't have did nothin'". Suddenly, WHAP, WHAP! Two spears pierce through the door, stopping inches from Danny's head. They turn and run.
related_events: Danny and Jimmy exit the room and close the door
Jimmy downplays the dealer's threat

name: Spears Through the Door
description: Danny and Jimmy step out of the room and close the door behind them. Danny looks at Jimmy and says, "Nice dealer you got there, Jimmy." Jimmy starts to respond, "Oh ... that. Ah, he was just juiced. He wouldn't have did nothin'" when suddenly WHAP, WHAP! Two spears punch through the cheap door, stopping just short of Danny's head. Without hesitation, both men turn and run.
related_events: Two spears pierce the door near Danny's head
Danny and Jimmy flee in panic

name: Tanner Drives Out of the Alley After Danny's Warning
description: Danny lies on the back seat of the car and says he has a hot lead, but he doesn't want to share it in the middle of the alley. Tanner, sitting in the front with his shaved head and blue eyes, remarks that Danny seems paranoid tonight. Danny replies that just because he's paranoid doesn't mean people aren't out to get him. Without another word, Tanner starts driving the car out of the alley.
related_events: Danny reports having a hot lead during a car ride
Tanner comments on Danny's paranoid demeanor
Tanner drives the car out of the alley

name: Danny Responds to Tanner with a Dark Warning
description: Tanner drives the car out of the alley, commenting on Danny's nervous attitude. From the back seat, Danny replies with a grim remark: just because you're paranoid doesn't mean people aren't out to slice your balls off and shove them down your throat.
related_events: Danny delivers a dark quip about paranoia and personal safety

name: Danny Hears the Fight Between the Dude and Colette
description: Danny entered the room just as an argument broke out next door between the dude and Colette. Shouts erupted—Colette screamed, and the dude yelled at the top of his lungs. A loud smack rang out, followed by silence. Colette began to sob. The dude spoke afterward in hushed, contrite tones.
related_events: Argument erupts between the dude and Colette
The dude yells at the top of his lungs
Colette screams during the altercation
Loud smack follows the argument
Physical struggle occurs during the argument
Colette sobs in silence after the struggle
The dude speaks in hushed, contrite tones after the fight

name: Danny Observes Meth Lab Setup and Makes Culinary Comparison
description: Danny moves along the kitchen counter, scanning containers filled with drain cleaner, hydrochloric acid, match heads, ether, and cold medicine. He notes each substance as part of the process to extract ephedrine, soon to be converted into methedrine. His gaze shifts to a collection of burners, beakers, and tubing arranged across the counter. A faint smirk appears as he compares the setup to a chef’s kitchen, muttering that the cook handles the equipment like Julia Child making bouillabaisse. Then, the cook pauses, eyes widening at something off in the reaction. Danny’s voice drops. "Oh-oh."
related_events: Danny observes chemical ingredients for meth production
Danny compares meth cook to Julia Child cooking bouillabaisse

name: The Cook Sees Something Go Wrong
description: The meth cook stares at the bubbling mixture, his expression shifting suddenly. His eyes widen as he catches sight of something off in the reaction. A faint plume of smoke curls from one of the beakers. Danny watches from nearby, his voice low. "Oh-oh."
related_events: Meth cook reacts with alarm to unexpected development

name: Danny and Jimmy Leave After Gun Purchase
description: Danny and Jimmy walk away from a decaying stucco apartment building. Danny slips a Glock into his pocket and carries a bulletproof vest over his shoulder. As they move down the street, Jimmy asks where Danny finds people like that. Jimmy mentions he usually finds them at the Del Ammo Mall, walking along. He asks if Danny wants to score some go-fast, but Danny declines. Jimmy looks at the vest and asks why Danny needs both a gun and a vest. Danny says it's for personal protection, adding that it's a dangerous world.
related_events: Danny and Jimmy walk away from an apartment building
Danny purchases a Glock handgun
Danny carries a bulletproof vest

name: Walking and Talking in the Fading Light
description: Danny and Jimmy walk away from a row of decaying stucco apartment buildings. Danny tucks a Glock into his pocket and carries a bulletproof vest over his shoulder. As they move down the sidewalk, Jimmy asks if Danny wants to score some stimulants. Danny declines. Jimmy glances at the vest and asks why Danny needs both a gun and the vest. Danny says it's for personal protection, then adds that it's a dangerous world, a very dangerous world.
related_events: Jimmy suggests scoring drugs
Jimmy asks about Danny's gun and vest
Danny justifies carrying protective gear

name: Alpha Team Rides Elevator with Courier
description: Danny and Creeper step into the elevator just as a courier enters carrying a medical sample case. The elevator doors close. Creeper stands in the corner, slumped and half-asleep, drool running down his chin. The others remain silent, wearing night vision goggles, police scanners, and two-way radios. The courier exits on the next floor, leaving the team alone in the elevator.
related_events: Alpha team enters elevator with courier
Courier exits elevator with medical sample case

name: Creeper Falls Asleep in Elevator
description: Creeper steps into the elevator and stands in the corner, slumping slightly as his eyes close. His head nods forward, and a line of drool runs from his mouth. The elevator doors slide shut while he remains motionless, barely awake.
related_events: Creeper stands asleep in elevator corner
Elevator door closes on dosing Creeper

name: Danny and Jimmy Confirm the Time
description: Danny and Jimmy the Finn walk toward the front door. Danny asks what time it is. Jimmy replies, "Twelve." Danny follows up, "Midnight?" Jimmy confirms, and they continue on their way.
related_events: Danny asks for the current time
Jimmy the Finn reports the time as twelve
Danny confirms the time is midnight

name: Danny and Jimmy on Duty Rotation
description: Danny and Jimmy the Finn walk toward the front door. Danny asks how they ended up with this assignment. Jimmy replies that it must be their turn. Danny nods and asks what time it is. Jimmy says twelve. Danny clarifies, 'Midnight?'
related_events: Jimmy the Finn responds to Danny's question about their assignment

name: Danny and Jimmy the Finn Approach the Front Door
description: Danny and Jimmy the Finn walk side by side toward the front door. Their footsteps fall in rhythm as they move across the pavement, closing the distance with steady strides. Danny glances at Jimmy, then ahead at the door, his hands in his pockets. Jimmy keeps his gaze forward, hands also tucked, shoulders slightly hunched against the night air. They do not speak as they approach.
related_events: Danny and Jimmy the Finn walk toward the front door

name: Kujo and Teams Intercept the Courier
description: Kujo emerges from the stairwell, wearing shorts, a tank top, and after-ski boots, a thick ring of powdered crank around his nostrils. He moves toward the courier just as Alpha team exits the elevator and begins advancing. At the same time, number two team approaches from the stairwell, positioning themselves to block the courier’s path to the lab. The courier is surrounded as the teams converge.
related_events: Alpha team follows from the elevator
Number two team moves to cut off the courier
Kujo approaches the courier from the stairwell

name: Creeper Wakes and Takes a Stance
description: Creeper, who had been asleep inside the elevator, wakes with a start and immediately drops into a karate stance.
related_events: Creeper wakes up suddenly inside the elevator
Creeper assumes a karate stance

name: Danny and Jimmy Step into the Noon Sun
description: Danny and Jimmy step out of a stucco apartment building into the blinding midday sun. The sky is bright, the air sharp with city noise. They slip on sunglasses and move along the sidewalk, shielding their eyes as they navigate the bustling intersection.
related_events: Danny and Jimmy emerge from the apartment building at noon

name: Danny and Jimmy Introduce Themselves
description: Danny and Jimmy walk through the busy business district, the sun glaring overhead. As they move along the sidewalk, Danny remarks that he’s seen Jimmy around and asks his name. Jimmy tells him his name is Jimmy, and that people call him Jimmy the Finn. Danny asks why, and Jimmy explains it’s because of his features—his face is Finnish. Danny responds with dry curiosity, and Jimmy adds that Finland is a country. They continue walking, side by side, under the noon light.
related_events: Danny and Jimmy introduce themselves during their walk

name: Jimmy the Finn Knows a Guy
description: The door opens to reveal the bright noon sun over a busy intersection, where a cheap stucco apartment building sits surrounded by commercial storefronts. Danny and Jimmy put on sunglasses and step out, shielding their eyes from the glare. Danny asks where they’re going. Jimmy says he knows a guy. Danny tells him to lead the way. They move along the sidewalk, keeping close to the buildings. Danny says he’s seen Jimmy around before and asks his name. Jimmy tells him his name is Jimmy, and everyone calls him Jimmy the Finn because of his Finnish features. Danny doesn’t respond. Jimmy adds that Finland is a country. Danny calls him Jimmy the Finn and says they should go score some gack.
related_events: Jimmy proposes visiting a drug connection
Danny and Jimmy plan to obtain drugs

name: Kujo Uses Peanuts to Assign Team Positions
description: He slides two peanuts behind the courier peanut. Kujo then pushes two more peanuts forward. He says he and Jimmy will be the number two team, stationed in the stairwell at the other end of the hall. The trashy dude walks into the bathroom. Danny glances at Colette again, and this time, she gives him a big smile.
related_events: Kujo slides peanuts to represent team positions
Kujo positions himself and Jimmy as number two team in the stairwell

name: Danny and Colette Share a Smile
description: Danny glances at Colette. This time, she sees him and responds with a big smile.
related_events: Danny exchanges a glance with Colette and receives a smile

name: Trashy Dude Enters Bathroom
description: The man described as trashy gets up and walks into the bathroom, closing the door behind him.
related_events: Trashy dude enters the bathroom

name: Jimmy Offers Drugs and Asks About JFK
description: Jimmy holds out a bullet dispenser of crank toward Danny, who is slouching in the passenger seat. Danny declines, saying he's good. Jimmy pockets the dispenser without comment. After a moment, Jimmy asks Danny what J.F.K. stands for. Danny tells him it's John Fitzgerald Kennedy. Jimmy asks if he was president, and Danny confirms. Jimmy drives in silence for a while, then calls Danny's name. Danny responds. Jimmy thanks him for not laughing.
related_events: Jimmy offers Danny a hit of crank from a bullet dispenser
Danny declines Jimmy's drug offer
Jimmy pockets the bullet dispenser of crank

name: Jimmy Asks About J.F.K.
description: Danny sat slouched in the passenger seat. Jimmy held out a bullet dispenser of crank. Danny declined. Jimmy put the dispenser away and asked what J.F.K. stood for. Danny said it stood for John Fitzgerald Kennedy. Jimmy asked if he was the president. Danny said yes. Jimmy drove in silence for a while, then thanked Danny for not laughing at him.
related_events: Jimmy asks Danny what J.F.K. stands for
Danny explains that J.F.K. stands for John Fitzgerald Kennedy
Jimmy confirms whether John Fitzgerald Kennedy was a president
Danny confirms that John Fitzgerald Kennedy was a president

name: Jimmy Thanks Danny for Not Laughing
description: Jimmy drives down the road after their conversation. After a stretch of silence, he turns to Danny and says, 'Thanks for not laughing at me.'
related_events: Jimmy continues driving after a period of conversation
Jimmy thanks Danny for not laughing at him

name: A Man Plays Trumpet in a Burning Room
description: A man lies on a bed in a room engulfed in flames, playing a trumpet. His white dress shirt is stained with a flower of blood. A duffle bag full of money burns beside him, flames curling at the edges, sending small burning fragments floating into the air. A photograph of a woman taped inside the trumpet case catches fire; only her smile remains visible as the rest turns to ash. A greeting card on the floor flaps open in the heat—its front shows a teddy bear and the word CONGRATULATIONS—inside, a blackened blood stain. The man speaks, his voice calm, as if addressing someone nearby. He names himself Tom Van Allen, then Danny Flynne, unsure which is true. He lists titles—avenging angel, Judas Iscariot, loving husband, prodigal son, the prince of Denmark—but offers no answers. After a pause, he says, 'Speed freak.' Another pause. 'That's as good a place as any.' The fire grows. He continues playing the trumpet, the music slow and mournful, a Spanish-tinged melody drifting through the roar of the flames.
related_events: Man experiences identity confusion while facing imminent death
Danny Flynne contemplates multiple conflicting identities
Danny Flynne self-identifies as speed freak

name: Man Plays Trumpet as Room Burns
description: The man lies on the bed, playing a slow, mournful trumpet piece. Flames spread across the room, swallowing the walls and ceiling. Inside the open trumpet case, a photograph of a woman catches fire, the edges curling and blackening, leaving only her smile visible before it turns to ash. A duffle bag full of money burns on the bed, bills flaring and drifting into the air like burning leaves. A gust from the fire lifts a greeting card from the floor, flipping it open to reveal a dark, bloodstained interior. The music continues, steady and clear, even as the fire grows.
related_events: Man plays haunting trumpet piece amid burning room
Photograph of woman burns inside trumpet case
Duffle bag of money ignites and burns on bed
Wind from fire blows greeting card open to reveal blood stain

name: Danny Flynne Explains the Tweaker World
description: Danny Flynne lies on a burning bed, a duffel bag of money ablaze beside him, flames curling around the edges of a photograph taped inside a trumpet case—only the woman's smile still visible. The room crackles with fire as he raises the trumpet to his lips, playing a slow, mournful Saeta. His white shirt is stained with a spreading flower of blood. Through the smoke and heat, his voice cuts in, steady and calm. He says he doesn’t know who he is anymore—Tom Van Allen, Danny Flynne, maybe neither, maybe both. He speaks of avenging angels, traitors, husbands, sons, princes. A greeting card flutters open on the floor, the word 'CONGRATULATIONS!' barely readable above a blackened bloodstain. He calls himself a speed freak. Pauses. Repeats it, as if testing the truth. Then, with the fire rising around him, he begins to tell the story of the tweaker world—the chaos, the rush, the unraveling—his voice the only clear sound in the burning room.
related_events: Danny Flynne introduces background on the tweaker subculture

name: Danny Helps a Neighbor with Spilled Groceries
description: Danny steps out of the stairwell and sees a woman one door down struggling with her groceries. As she tries to open her door, a bag rips and its contents spill onto the floor. Danny approaches and says, 'Let me help you with those.' The woman quickly gathers the items and hurries into her room, closing the door sharply behind her. Danny calls out through the door, then notices a can left on the floor. He picks it up, reads the Chinese label, and says he’ll leave it by the door. After a pause, the door opens. He holds out the can with a smile and tells her she should be more careful in such a neighborhood. The woman thanks him, apologizes for being rude, and says she’s new here. Danny introduces himself. She tells him her name is Colette Aragon, takes the can, and closes the door again.
related_events: Woman's grocery bag breaks and spills contents
Danny offers to help woman with groceries
Woman collects groceries and slams door

name: Danny Returns the Forgotten Can
description: After the woman hurriedly closes her door, Danny notices a can left on the floor. He bends down to pick it up and looks at the label, which is written in Chinese. He calls out that he’s leaving the can by her door, waits a moment with no response, and places it near the entrance.
related_events: Danny finds and picks up abandoned can
Danny reads label on can and identifies it as Chinese
Danny announces he is leaving the can by the door

name: Returning the Can and Exchanging Names
description: Danny stands by the woman's door holding the can of fermented soybean curd. When she opens the door, he hands it to her with a smile and says she should be more careful, adding that it's not a good neighborhood. She apologizes, explaining she's new around here. He passes her the can and asks what it is. She tells him it's fermented soybean curd. He says, 'Yummy.' She smiles. He introduces himself as Danny Flynne. After a pause, she tells him her name is Colette Aragon and thanks him. She closes the door.
related_events: Danny returns can to woman with a smile
Woman apologizes and explains she is new
Danny hands over the can and asks about its contents
Danny comments on the food and introduces himself
Woman reveals her name and thanks Danny

name: Danny Watches the Binge Unravel
description: Danny sits in an armchair, his eyes heavy, watching the others. Kujo paces a tight line of words, talking fast about the alphabet—how many letters there are, how vowels don’t make sense, how sometimes y counts. His voice doesn’t stop. On the floor, Nancy and Teresa empty a drawer of socks, spreading them out, then folding and refolding each one, lining them up again with careful precision. Creeper and Jimmy the Finn sit pressed into the couch, jaws moving slowly, their stares fixed on nothing. Blankets and tinfoil cover the windows, sealing out the light. The room hums with a restless energy. Danny blinks, silent, as the air thickens. Then Kujo stops mid-sentence and shouts: OH SHIT! WE'RE OUT OF DRUGS!
related_events: Danny observes the aftermath of a prolonged drug binge
Group of meth users engages in compulsive, ritualistic behaviors during a drug binge
Nancy and Teresa meticulously rearrange folded socks in a drawer
Kujo delivers an obsessive monologue about the alphabet

name: Danny Questions How Long They've Been Awake
description: Danny sits in the armchair, watching the others. The noise in the room fades until there is only silence. He looks around at Nancy and Teresa folding socks, at Kujo still talking, at Creeper and Jimmy staring ahead. His voice comes softly, as if to himself. He wonders if they’ve been awake for three days or four. He blinks slowly, his gaze steady on the room. The blankets and tinfoil remain taped over the windows. No one responds. The moment stretches, quiet and still.
related_events: Auditory perception fades out during Danny's observation
Danny reflects on the distorted passage of time during the drug binge

name: Kujo Announces the Drugs Are Gone
description: Kujo suddenly stops talking and stares at the empty bag on the table. His eyes widen. He slams his hand down and shouts, 'OH SHIT! WE'RE OUT OF DRUGS!' The room freezes. Nancy and Teresa look up from the socks. Creeper and Jimmy stop grinding their teeth. Danny blinks, slowly turning his head toward the sound. The silence that follows is thick and unbroken.
related_events: Kujo exclaims that the group has run out of drugs

name: Woman Screams at Crime Scene as Child Clings to Her
description: Bobby's woman screams at the top of her lungs, straining to reach Bobby's sheet-covered body. A little girl clutches tightly to the woman's legs, her face pressed against the fabric of her clothes. The woman stumbles forward, voice breaking, while the child remains silent, holding on as the crowd watches.
related_events: Bobby's woman screams while trying to reach Bobby's body
Little girl clutches at screaming woman's legs

name: Blood Flows to Storm Drain with Loud Splatter
description: A ribbon of blood snakes from Bobby's sheet-covered body, trailing across the parking lot curb and into a storm drain. It falls through the dark pipe and splatters at the bottom, striking a pool of stagnant water with an unnaturally loud sound.
related_events: Blood from Bobby's body flows into storm drain
Blood splatters loudly at bottom of drain

name: Danny Appears Among the Onlookers
description: Danny stands among the crowd in the parking lot, his face unreadable as chaos unfolds around him. A woman screams, struggling to reach Bobby’s sheet-covered body, while a little girl clings to her legs. Nearby, a SWAT officer performs a slow, graceful Tai-Chi motion as the team packs up their equipment. A trail of blood snakes from beneath the sheet, spilling over the curb and into a storm drain, where it splatters into a pool of dirty water with an unnaturally loud sound.
related_events: Danny is revealed among the onlookers with neutral expression

name: SWAT Team Member Performs Tai-Chi Gesture
description: As the SWAT team packs up their equipment in the parking lot, one officer pauses and executes a slow, graceful Tai-Chi movement. The motion cuts through the tension, brief and deliberate, before the surrounding activity resumes.
related_events: SWAT team member performs a Tai-Chi gesture while packing up

name: Danny Retrieves and Prepares the Trumpet
description: Danny opens the lock box and pulls out a trumpet case. He carries it to a cheap vanity, sits down in front of the mirror, and stares at his reflection for a long time. Slowly, he lifts the lid of the case, revealing a gleaming horn inside.
related_events: Danny retrieves trumpet case from lock box
Danny sits in front of mirror at vanity
Danny opens trumpet case to reveal gleaming horn

name: Discovering the Trumpet and the Photograph
description: Danny opens the trumpet case and runs his fingers along the gleaming horn. Inside the lid, a photograph of a woman is taped, her expression self-conscious, as if caught mid-protest. He lifts the trumpet from the case and finds a life insurance check and a driver's license beneath it. The license bears his face but the name Tom Van Allen.
related_events: Danny touches trumpet and notices photograph
Danny removes trumpet from case and discovers check and driver's license

name: Danny Becomes Tom Van Allen
description: Danny stands in front of the mirror, holding a trumpet. He looks at his reflection and says, 'My name is Tom Van Allen. I play the trumpet.' He repeats the words again, his voice steady. Then he lifts the trumpet to his lips and begins to play 'Saeta.' As the music fills the room, an image appears on the wall beside him—a vast lake surrounded by desert. The sound continues, steady and clear, as the scene holds.
related_events: Danny declares identity as Tom Van Allen
Danny begins playing the trumpet, triggering a visual projection

name: Danny Plays the Trumpet and a Lake Appears on the Wall
description: Danny sits in front of the mirror, opens a trumpet case, and takes out a gleaming horn. He runs his fingers along its length, then removes a check and a driver's license with his photo and the name Tom Van Allen. He places the trumpet to his lips and begins to play. As the music fills the room, a large image of a huge lake in the middle of a desert appears on the blank wall beside him. The image grows clearer as the sound continues, filling the space with light and reflection.

He playfully tackles her into the sand, and she laughs, pushing him off after calling him gross for his wiener breath. He rolls beside her and spoons against her in the sand. He tells her the music feels melancholy because he thinks about what life would be like without her. She smiles, presses closer, and suggests they spend the night on the beach. He points out there’s no motel nearby, but she insists—they should stay right there. He doesn’t answer, but stays close, the two of them watching the dark settle over the water.

name: Pooh-Bear's Pigeon Assassination Reenactment
description: Pooh-Bear crouched with the remote control in hand, eyes locked on the small car trundling down the driveway. Inside the car, four pigeons sat taped in place, their heads bobbing slightly as the vehicle rolled forward. He raised his free hand, then snapped it down. "FIRE!" Three pellet guns cracked in unison. From the super-8 camera, the footage showed a sudden explosion of feathers as the birds were struck. The car wobbled but kept moving. Pooh-Bear jumped to his feet, pumping his fist. "Yes! Yes!" he shouted. "Out! That's a wrap. Good job, boys. Good job."
related_events: Three shooters simultaneously fire pellet guns at pigeons
Pigeons are hit and feathers scatter in grainy footage
Pooh-Bear celebrates successful simulation

name: Pooh-Bear Wraps Up the Reenactment
description: Pooh-Bear lowered the remote control and announced the simulation was over, pumping his fist in satisfaction. He praised the men for their work, then walked over and took the super-8 camera from Zapruder, holding it up as if inspecting the footage. He turned to Danny and Jimmy, who had been standing quietly at the edge of the yard, and asked what they thought. Danny shrugged and said it was cool. Jimmy added it was interesting. Pooh-Bear nodded, still holding the camera, then muttered something about sending the film to Oliver Stone.
related_events: Pooh-Bear ends simulation and praises participants
Pooh-Bear takes super-8 camera from Zapruder
Pooh-Bear asks Danny and Jimmy for feedback on the simulation
Danny and Jimmy give lukewarm reactions to the simulation

name: Pooh-Bear's Reenactment and the Surviving Pigeon
description: Oswald stood over the remote-controlled car, prodding one of the pigeons with the tip of his pellet gun. The bird stirred, its wings twitching. He turned to Pooh-Bear. "J.F.K.'s still alive. Should I finish him off?" Pooh-Bear, holding the super-8 camera, paused. He had just declared he would send the footage to the Warren Commission, but Danny spoke up. "I think the Warren Commission has been closed for a while." Pooh-Bear considered this, then shrugged. "Fuck it. I'll send it to Oliver Stone then. He'll get them to reopen the bastard."

Oswald checks injured pigeon with pellet gun
Oswald asks whether to kill surviving pigeon

name: Man Passes Out in Yard, Dog Urinates on Him
description: A man lies motionless in the front yard of a sprawling ranch house tucked into the desert hills. A dog approaches, sniffs at him, then begins urinating on his body. The man does not stir. Nearby, a pile of dead pigeons rests along the driveway. The scene remains still, the man unresponsive, the dog wandering off.
related_events: Guy passes out in front yard of ranch house
Dog urinates on unconscious man

name: Tanner Pays Danny for His Cooperation
description: Tanner sits across from Danny at a picnic table and begins counting several hundred-dollar bills, carefully writing down their serial numbers. Once he finishes, he places the cash inside an envelope, licks the flap, seals it, and slides it over to Danny. Danny remains silent, watching but not touching the envelope. The two exchange words about Danny’s role and the risks involved. Eventually, Danny takes the envelope and stuffs it into his jacket. The exchange is complete.
related_events: Tanner counts and transfers cash to Danny in a sealed envelope
Danny initially refuses but eventually accepts the envelope of money

name: Danny and Tanner Talk at the Picnic Table
description: Danny and Tanner sit across from each other at a picnic table. Tanner counts several hundred-dollar bills, writes down serial numbers, and places the cash in an envelope. He licks and seals it, then slides it to Danny, who leaves it untouched. Danny asks if Tanner thinks he's a Judas. Tanner replies that it's hard to compare the people Danny is taking down to the Lord. Danny says Garcetti thinks he's a pile of shit. Tanner says Garcetti thinks everything is shit, even dolphins, and shakes his head with a smile. Danny thanks Tanner for not judging him. Tanner says it's not his place. Danny asks if Tanner ever wonders why he does it. Tanner lists possible reasons—money, drugs, staying out of jail—and says he knows the drill. Danny asks if Tanner finds that repugnant. Tanner says it's just the way the world works and adds that, as far as tweakers go, Danny isn't a bad guy and hasn't hurt anyone but himself. Danny mentions Bobby, and his wife and kid. Tanner says Bobby laid his own tracks, could have gone quietly, but played the hard-ass till the end, and that Bobby's family is better off without him. He tells Danny to take the money. Danny puts the envelope in his jacket. Tanner asks how Danny got into this situation, saying Danny seems like a smart guy. Danny says it's a long story and maybe he'll tell him someday.
related_events: Danny thanks Tanner for withholding judgment
Danny expresses guilt over betraying Bobby and affecting his family
Tanner rationalizes Danny's actions as survival in a flawed system
Tanner questions Danny about his motivations for being an informant

name: Tanner Asks How Danny Ended Up an Informant
description: Tanner sits across from Danny at a picnic table after counting out several hundred-dollar bills and sealing them in an envelope, which Danny eventually pockets. As Danny watches, Tanner asks how he ended up becoming an informant, saying he seems smart enough to have avoided such a path. Danny replies that it's a long story and maybe he'll tell it someday. The conversation ends without further explanation.
related_events: Tanner asks how Danny became an informant despite appearing intelligent
Danny declines to share the full story of his past decisions

name: Garcetti Reveals the Threat from Domingo
description: Garcetti emerges from the men's room and joins Danny and Tanner at the picnic table. He tells Danny that Domingo, the man he helped imprison, is connected to the Mexicali Boys and knows someone betrayed him. Garcetti leans in and describes the Colombian necktie—a method of execution where the throat is slit and the tongue pulled through the wound—saying Domingo has threatened to do it to the informant. Danny recoils, swats Garcetti’s hand away, and demands he stop. He turns to Tanner, saying if Domingo finds out it was him, he’s dead. Tanner assures him Domingo won’t discover his identity, given how many people Domingo sold to. Garcetti mocks Danny, asking if he’s forgotten about his unresolved drug possession charge, and questions why he’s acting like a smart-ass. Tanner tells Danny to keep his cover intact and promises the charges will be dropped.

name: Danny Proposes a Drug Deal to Pooh-Bear
description: Danny sits in the kitchen with Pooh-Bear, who is eating scrambled eggs from a plate on his lap. Pooh-Bear mentions that Jimmy told him about a proposition Danny wants to make. Danny confirms it, saying he has a buyer looking for a quarter pound of high-quality drugs. Pooh-Bear asks whether it’s crank or glass, and Danny replies it’s the good stuff, asking if Pooh-Bear can supply it. Chewing his food, Pooh-Bear nods and offers Danny a taste of his eggs. Danny declines at first, but Pooh-Bear insists, so he accepts a bite. After tasting, Danny says it’s not bad, and Pooh-Bear winks, calling it a secret recipe. Danny brings up price, suggesting $14,000 a kilo. Pooh-Bear dismisses metric units and says he deals in U.S. pounds. Danny adjusts, offering $6,000 per ounce. Pooh-Bear agrees enthusiastically, saying he’ll do it for a dear friend. Danny is surprised by how quickly Pooh-Bear accepts, and says they’ve just met. Pooh-Bear replies that since Danny is Jimmy’s friend, he considers him a brother. As Pooh-Bear eats more eggs, Danny calculates the total—40 pounds at $6,000 per pound. Pooh-Bear says if Danny says so, it’s fine. Danny grows uneasy, feeling Pooh-Bear isn’t taking him seriously. Pooh-Bear responds with a smile that maybe Danny is the one not taking him seriously. He says he welcomed Danny openly and finds it disrespectful that Danny tried to lowball him. Danny tries to object, but Pooh-Bear interrupts, saying he wants to tell a story about the last person who tried to cheat him.
related_events: Danny proposes a drug purchase deal to Pooh-Bear
Pooh-Bear agrees to sell drugs at an unexpectedly low price

name: Pooh-Bear Forces Danny to Eat Drug-Laced Eggs
description: Pooh-Bear offers Danny a bite of his scrambled eggs, pressing him to accept despite Danny’s initial refusal. Insisting it’s delicious and part of his secret recipe, Pooh-Bear shovels a portion into Danny’s mouth. Danny tastes it and says it’s not bad. Pooh-Bear winks and continues eating, then shifts the conversation to business as Danny attempts to negotiate a drug deal.
related_events: Pooh-Bear offers Danny scrambled eggs containing drugs

name: Danny Questions the Deal, Pooh-Bear Responds with a Story of Violence
description: Danny grows uneasy after Pooh-Bear agrees too quickly to the price, and voices his concern that he isn’t being taken seriously. Pooh-Bear responds by smiling and suggesting Danny may be the one not showing proper respect. He then recounts a story about a man who once shorted him money, describing how he clamped the man’s head in a vice and cut his skull open with a Saws All. As Pooh-Bear speaks, his expression remains calm and his grin never fades. Danny sits in silence, visibly tense, as Pooh-Bear lights a cigarette and stares at him.
related_events: Danny expresses suspicion about Pooh-Bear's sincerity
Pooh-Bear threatens Danny with a violent story about past retaliation

name: Pooh-Bear Serves Eggs and a Warning
description: Pooh-Bear sits in the kitchen eating scrambled eggs, offering some to Danny, who reluctantly accepts. After Danny comments on the taste, Pooh-Bear continues eating and agrees to a drug deal at an unexpectedly low price. Danny grows suspicious, feeling disrespected. Pooh-Bear smiles and insists he’s serious, then shifts tone, accusing Danny of trying to low-ball him. He begins telling a story about a man who once shorted him eleven dollars. As he speaks, Pooh-Bear describes clamping the man’s head in a vice and cutting his skull open with a Saws All, his voice calm and steady. Danny shifts uncomfortably, his anxiety rising. Pooh-Bear lights a cigarette and reveals that he removed the man’s brain, kept it in his freezer, and has been eating it mixed into his food ever since. He gestures to the eggs on his plate and grins. Danny stares, stunned, his face pale.
related_events: Pooh-Bear uses a flashback narrative to illustrate his ruthlessness
Pooh-Bear describes using a saw to cut open a man's skull
Pooh-Bear removes and takes another man's brain
Pooh-Bear stores the brain in his freezer

name: Danny and Pooh-Bear Finalize the Drug Deal
description: Danny stands up from the table, pushing his chair back as if to leave, his face tight with tension. Pooh-Bear watches him, still smiling, not moving. After a beat, Pooh-Bear speaks, his voice calm. Eight thousand a pound. Danny stops. He turns back, considers the offer, then nods. That’s my number, he says. Pooh-Bear leans forward, extends his hand. Danny hesitates, then shakes it. For a moment, neither speaks. Then Pooh-Bear chuckles softly. I like you, he says. You’ve got nerve.

name: The Cow Brains Prank
description: After finalizing the deal, Pooh-Bear stands up, walks to the kitchen counter, and pulls a crumpled grocery store receipt and a sealed package of cow brains from the trash. He tosses the package onto the table in front of Danny. A flashback shows Pooh-Bear earlier that morning in a grocery store, placing a package of cow brains into his cart with a smirk. Back in the kitchen, he chuckles and tells Danny that the scrambled eggs he just ate were made with the cow brains—store-bought, legal, and harmless. Danny stares at the package, then at Pooh-Bear, his expression shifting from confusion to realization. Pooh-Bear leans back in his chair, lights another cigarette, and bursts into laughter, watching Danny’s discomfort with amusement.

Flashback reveals Pooh-Bear buying cow brains at grocery store
